nodes.label: Deterministic, self-contained phase-one situation judgement rule engine.
Validate a plain/GeoJSON polygon without changing existing geometry.
Approximate point-to-segment distance in meters in a local tangent plane.
Match GeoJSON/plain polygon areas or line routes with a metric tolerance.
Return a deterministic horizontal distance for matching-plan ranking.
Build a contract-aligned candidate for special non-catalog results.
Calculates cluster analyses and event suggestions for one snapshot.
Preload legacy dependencies and the formation model.          Returns a per-it
Project the single long public trajectory into the legacy motion window.
Evaluate one member independently without inheriting peer risk.
Return compliance exemption for exactly one UAV target.          Exemption is
Fraction of long-window points inside both route and altitude corridors.
Evaluate every enabled rule, then select once using the shared policy.
